verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Change my heart O God
Make it ever true

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Change my heart O God
Make me more like you

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
Change my heart of stone
To a heart of love

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
Take my selfishness
And teach me Lord to serve

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
You are the potter
I am the clay

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
Mould me and make me
This Lord I pray
